name: Sessions Health vs SimplePractice
title: Sessions Health vs SimplePractice: Affordable EHR Comparison for Therapists
description: Compare Sessions Health and SimplePractice for mental health practices. See differences in pricing, features, and value for solo therapists and small groups.

summary.bottom_line: Sessions Health is the budget-friendly option with a free tier, transparent pricing, and no hidden fees—designed by a therapist who understands the therapeutic alliance. SimplePractice offers more advanced features including e-prescribing, AI notes, and broader integrations but at higher cost. Choose Sessions Health for affordability and simplicity; choose SimplePractice for comprehensive features and e-prescribing.

sections.heading: Sessions Health vs SimplePractice: Overview
sections.content: Sessions Health and SimplePractice both serve mental health professionals but with different philosophies. Sessions Health was co-founded by psychotherapist Ian Felton with a focus on affordability, ethical pricing, and respect for the therapeutic alliance. SimplePractice is the market leader with 250,000+ practitioners, offering a comprehensive feature set with paid add-ons for advanced capabilities. Sessions Health positions itself as 'the most philosophically-aligned EHR company mental health providers can trust' with transparent pricing and no forced price increases.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Sessions Health offers significantly lower pricing with a free tier (up to 3 clients) and Professional plan at $39/month for unlimited clients. Additional practitioners are $29/month each with unlimited free admin staff. SimplePractice starts at $49/month (Starter) but requires Essential ($79/mo) for telehealth and Plus ($99/mo) for full features. SimplePractice add-ons (AI $35/mo, e-prescribe $49/mo) increase total cost. Sessions Health emphasizes no hidden fees—reminders, portal, and storage are included.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: SimplePractice has more advanced features: e-prescribing, native mobile app, AI note-taking, and broader calendar integrations (including Outlook). Sessions Health focuses on core EHR essentials with outcome tracking (PHQ-9, GAD-7) included. SimplePractice includes telehealth on Essential and Plus plans; Sessions Health charges $10/month for telehealth. For practices needing e-prescribing or mobile access, SimplePractice is necessary. For budget-conscious therapists wanting solid basics, Sessions Health delivers more value per dollar.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your budget and feature requirements:

recommendations.when: You're a solo therapist or small practice prioritizing affordability, want transparent pricing without surprises, don't need e-prescribing or mobile app, or are just starting out (use free tier)
You need e-prescribing, want a native mobile app, prefer AI documentation assistance, or run a larger practice that benefits from the broader ecosystem
You've experienced price increases from other EHRs and want stable, ethical pricing from a therapist-founded company

faqs.a: Sessions Health offers a permanent free tier for up to 3 active clients with full features. The Professional plan at $39/month covers unlimited clients. This makes it ideal for therapists just starting their practice.

faqs.q: Does Sessions Health have a mobile app like SimplePractice?
faqs.a: No, Sessions Health does not have a native mobile app. SimplePractice offers iOS and Android apps for managing your practice on the go. If mobile app access is essential, SimplePractice has the advantage.

faqs.q: Which is better for a solo therapist on a budget?
faqs.a: Sessions Health is significantly more affordable: free for small caseloads, $39/month for unlimited clients vs. SimplePractice's $49-99/month. Sessions Health also includes features (like reminders and storage) that cost extra elsewhere.

Sessions Health does not offer e-prescribing, making it unsuitable for psychiatrists who prescribe medications. SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as a $49/month add-on. Psychiatrists should choose SimplePractice or Valant.
